scheme_name: Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a ward of an Ex‑Serviceman (ESM) or a ward of the widow of an Ex‑Serviceman (ESM)
The applicant (or the widow’s ward) must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
The sporting event must be organised by a body approved/recognised by the Government
Applicant must have achieved merit in a sport at the national or international level
The application must be submitted offline within three months from the date of the achievement
benefits_summary: Grant of ₹50,000 for international‑level achievements and ₹30,000 for national‑level achievements, credited to the beneficiary’s bank account via RTGS/NEFT.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
